_about: Find it (docs/find-it-design.md): the search engine's data. Scenes (anchors and hide spots, with the relation each spot has to its anchor), look-alike groups, mechanic levels and the story. Every Kutchi word is borrowed: from data/cook.json (shared with Cook) or from data/content.json (the content master), listed in words.from_content. Nothing here is Kutchi; nothing is invented. A word with no Kutchi yet shows as a grey English placeholder.

words._about: Merged into the shared word table (Cook.data.words) when find.html loads: the Kutchi draft and English from the content master, and the item picture. Word progress is shared with Cook (one save, one purse).

lookalike_groups._about: Decoys come from the target's own group, so whichever member is asked for, the group looks the same (design s6). Grouped by what they look like at a glance: colour, size and shape.

cognates._about: Drafts that sound or read like English (peach, kivi, cheree, litchi). A non-speaker can guess these from the row, so they are not a Kutchi test: the leak check (build/test_find.py --leak) reports them, and the list never asks for them while cognateTargets is false. They still appear as decoys, and Nani names them in recasts.

ear.name: Understood
ear.tip: Understood: the right things, the right number, and the shopkeeper's mistake spotted

hand.name: Sharp eyes
hand.tip: Sharp eyes: quick finds, one after another, without tapping everywhere

relaxed.name: No help
relaxed.tip: No help: no second replays, hints, reveals or translations

busy.name: Quick
busy.tip: Quick: done before the shopkeeper's patience ran out

help._about: Help costs (design s5.3). Hearing it again: the first replay is free, then the no-help star (Relaxed) or patience seconds (Busy). Warmer: the no-help star and the combo. Reveal, translate and 'shown': the ear star too. No upgrade ever makes these cheaper.

bazaar._about: The fruit stall (camera E). Background, shopkeeper and the carried basket come from data/scenes/bazaar.json (the fruit errand's scene), so both errands share one layout. Anchors are tappable scenery, never targets. Spots are hide spots: each is one (anchor, relation). Painted findables in the placeholder art (tomatoes, chillies, garlic, onions) are never asked for here.

mechanics._about: Every tuning number, per level (design s3, s4.3). Level 1 is the game as it is; each later level lists only what changes. rows: list rows. groups: look-alike groups the rows come from. count/spare: how many are asked for, and how many more of that thing are on the stall (always more than asked, so 'take them all' is never the answer). decoyKinds/decoyCopies: look-alikes from the same groups (then other groups). clutterKinds: vegetables that aren't on any list. maxItems: the clutter cap. maxUnits: the basket's room. noRow: chance of a 'no X' row (its X is always on the stall). parMs: a find within this long (from the end of Nani's line or the last find) is quick, for the sharp-eyes star. slowTaps: this many wrong items within this many ms makes the stall pause for slowMs. hesitateMs: Nani says the list again (free) after this long without a find. bag.errors: what the shopkeeper gets wrong (swap: a look-alike instead of one thing; extra: one too many).

list.name: Nani's list
list.goal: Find what Nani asked for, as many as she said, then press Done.

bag.name: Check the bag
bag.goal: The shopkeeper packed your bag. One thing is wrong: tap it.

story.chapter: Arc 1, Chapter 1: The guests are coming
story.title: Fruit from the bazaar
story.gist: Guests are coming tonight! Nani has sent you to the fruit stall with her list.

ear.wrong: Listen to the list again (the speaker on each row) before you tap.
ear.count: The number is in Nani's list: count as you pick, then press Done.
ear.no: One row says what NOT to buy. Leave that one on the stall.
ear.bag: Check the bag against Nani's list: what didn't she ask for?
ear.shown: Try without the eye, the English or the glow next time.

hand.default: Look along the crates, the counter and the baskets in order: quick finds keep the combo going.
hand.slow: Slow down: tapping everywhere makes the stall pause.

third.relaxed: Try it with no hints: listen, then find.
third.busy: Be quicker: the ring shows how long the shopkeeper will wait.
